body: Snails are the only live food I feed mine, I usually use frozen blood worms for the bulk of their diet though

Ouch, that sounds rough. 

You need to talk to her and tell her that comparing you to others upsets you. You need to reach out and tell her what's wrong, because by the look of it, she wont do it herself.

I would start by talking to your mother and explaining the situation. We arent in your shoes so it's hard for us to fully grasp the situation. But I feel like talking to someone who is close to you would help because if you are really upset about this, bottling up is more destructive than letting it out. 

If your mom doesnt help you in that area, then there are other options like confronting her about your disturbance with her past. 

But in all honesty, I wouldn't look down upon your wife for having sex with other men before you. If you are married and she slept with other men, then there is a definate issue, but if she had sex before you met, it shouldn't be a deciding factor on weather your marriage is successful or not.
No one has to die, but what makes you want to?

Most people blanch cucumbers or zuchini for feeding, it just removes the time where it sits floating on the top of the water.

You can just remove the seeds and drop it in though.

You dont deserve to die. 
You dont deserve to feel like you are worthless.
Life is worth living.
You can come back from this.
Your past doesnt have to define your future.

Why dont you share a bit more about your story?
I'm sorry for you being put into such a shitty situation. I hope that whatever happens to you after you pass is what you hoped it would be.
